capabilities: Present the current note as slides split at headings and --- rules
Navigate slides via keyboard, click, or a slide outline sidebar
Reveal blocks step by step within a slide
Hide presenter notes written in a callout
Set per-note break level and add a cover slide with title and description
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists v1 limitations: footnotes land on the last slide, the deck is a snapshot refreshed manually or on tab focus, and some themes misbehave at large font scales (workaround via extra container classes and CSS snippets).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to present a note directly as a slide deck that keeps all rendered content such as embeds, callouts, Bases, and LaTeX.

relations.evidence: minimal, typography-driven slides — the way Dropbox Paper did it

summary: Presents the current note as minimal, typography-driven slides split at headings, rendering everything the note shows in reading view.
